//: The last-place punishment, one entry per season, keyed by season.
A SEASON WITH NO ENTRY HAD NO PUNISHMENT, and renders nothing anywhere —
that is the normal state for most years, not a gap to be filled in.
WHO OWES IT IS NEVER WRITTEN HERE. The site already derives last place from
the toilet bowl or the consolation ladder; naming them again would be a
second source to disagree with the first.
punishment  required; the entry is ignored without it
completed   ISO YYYY-MM-DD, or true for done on a date nobody recorded.
Absent means it has not been done yet
notes       optional, and RENDERED — it is for something a reader wants
(where it happened, how it went), never a bylaw reference or
anything else internal. The bylaws are linked from the site;
citing them in the panel just makes it read like paperwork.

2025.punishment: NFL combine events, chugging a beer before each one.
